summary: Vendor invoice amount not matching PO allocation for QuantumWorks LLC — need payment routing and PO assignment
amount_discrepancy: Invoice total $18,450.00 vs PO allocations summing $15,000.00 (split across PO-3121 and PO-3122).
description:
Issue summary: A vendor invoice from QuantumWorks LLC (invoice #QW-2026-0309) arrived on 2026-03-09 for $18,450.00. The invoice references two POs (PO-3121 and PO-3122) in the vendor-supplied PDF, but our NetSuite allocation shows PO-3121 and PO-3122 with remaining budgets totaling $15,000.00. Impact: Payment cannot be scheduled until the invoice is reconciled to POs. This blocks the March 15 AP payment run for QuantumWorks (they are a critical vendor for infra maintenance). Environment: NetSuite production (company: Redwood Inference), AP shared mailbox, vendor portal record ID: VW-8853.

Observed behavior: AP workflow flags the invoice as "PO mismatch" and prevents auto-approval. Finance ops attempted to apply the invoice to PO-3121 and PO-3122; NetSuite rejected the allocation for the remaining $3,450.00 due to no open PO lines.

Expected behavior: Either the vendor has separate invoice lines referencing a valid third PO (PO-3125) or we should be able to create a one-off PO/expense allocation to cover the remainder and proceed with payment.

Attachments: vendor_invoice_QW-2026-0309.pdf (attached to ticket), NetSuite screenshot of PO allocations (screenshot attached), AP email thread.
steps_to_reproduce: Open NetSuite > Transactions > Enter Vendor Bill > Search for AP-INV-2026-0309
Review the referenced PO lines on the vendor PDF and compare to NetSuite PO-3121/PO-3122 line balances
Attempt to allocate remaining invoice amount to existing POs and observe NetSuite rejection message: 'No open line items available for this PO'
Attempt to create manual GL-only bill and observe internal policy blocker because vendor requires PO-backed bill for this category
logs: NetSuite error (2026-03-11 14:22 UTC): 'INSUFFICIENT_PO_LINES - No open line items available for this PO'
AP mailbox entry (2026-03-09 09:10 UTC): vendor PDF received from billing@quantumworks.com
Payment schedule snapshot (2026-03-12): QuantumWorks payment pending in March 15 batch (status: Held - PO mismatch)
comments: 2026-03-12 10:05 - Aisha Patel: Created ticket after seeing invoice queued in AP with PO mismatch. Attached vendor PDF. Need guidance on whether we can create a catch-all PO or require vendor reissue.

2026-03-12 14:30 - Procurement (Tomás García): Checked POs. PO-3121 and PO-3122 were for previous sprints; remaining open amounts are $9,000 and $6,000 respectively. No PO-3125 exists in the system. Suggest reaching out to vendor to confirm invoice breakdown or create a one-time PO for balance under 'emergency vendor services'.

2026-03-13 09:12 - Maya Chen: Tried to apply manual allocation in NetSuite. System blocked due to category requiring PO for approval. Escalating to AP sysadmin to check vendor record settings and category override policy.

2026-03-13 16:48 - AP Sysadmin (Liam O'Connor): Found vendor profile flagged as 'PO required' for expense category 'infrastructure-maintenance'. Can temporarily waive rule but needs PO creation via procurement. Created internal SR INT-4831 to request an ad-hoc PO if procurement approves.

2026-03-14 08:30 - Procurement (Tomás García): Procurement approved creation of ad-hoc PO-3189 for $3,450.00 to cover remainder. PO-3189 created and linked in NetSuite. AP to retry allocation and include PO-3189 on the vendor bill.
investigation_notes: Reviewed AP ledger and vendor portal: invoice lines do not explicitly map percentages to existing POs; vendor used a single 'Misc' line referencing both POs by number in the footer.
Hypothesis 1: Vendor mis-allocated lines and intended to bill an additional PO that wasn't created (missing PO-3189).
Hypothesis 2: PO lines were partially consumed by earlier change orders; NetSuite doesn't allow split allocations without explicit PO line remainers.
Checked procurement history: there was an approved change order on 2026-02-28 that consumed part of PO-3122, leaving smaller open amount than vendor assumed.
Verified vendor contract terms: requires PO-backed invoices for services; finance policy disallows GL-only exceptions without procurement approval.

Contact attempts: emailed billing@quantumworks.com 2026-03-12 and called vendor contact (Luis Rivera) 2026-03-13; vendor confirmed they will reissue an itemized invoice if requested but prefers a one-time PO approach to expedite payment.
resolution: 2026-03-14 09:10 - Temporary resolution: Procurement created ad-hoc PO-3189 for $3,450.00 and linked to vendor bill in NetSuite. AP retried allocation and invoice now balances across PO-3121, PO-3122, and PO-3189.
Payment action: QuantumWorks invoice marked Approved and queued for March 15 payment run (payment method: ACH). Finance ops to confirm funds sweep post-run and notify vendor.

Follow-up actions: Create a small process change to require vendors to itemize invoices with explicit PO line mappings for split-PO billing. Created internal task INT-4850 to update vendor onboarding checklist and AP automation to detect ambiguous PO references.
Customer/vendor communication: Maya to send confirmation email to Luis Rivera at QuantumWorks confirming payment scheduled and requesting reissued itemized invoice for their records.
